summary_md: **Wojak | AI × Web3 Dev ([@WojakTheDev](https://x.com/WojakTheDev/status/2115364446323494923))** shows **Strata**, a disk-offloading launcher that runs DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on a single GPU with ~46-64 GB RAM and exposes an OpenAI-compatible API usable from Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode; he notes it needs lots of SSD and gives only a few tok/s on consumer GPUs.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - Niko1221/Strata: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on any consumer hardware: one-click install for Windows / Linux. Strata inference engine, OpenAI/Anthropic API on localhost, optional image input.

relevance: Low-end path to a frontier open model behind agent harnesses, with honest speed caveats.
